main.result_summary:
The 2001-10-24 consolidation is committed as `26cc4df8` and not pushed, as the brief says the runner pushes. Lint and `sleep-audit.py` were both green before the commit, so no repair or reset was needed. Of the 61 messages with notes, 54 are cited in memory and 7 are listed in `dataset/drops/sleep-104.tsv`, which leaves none missing. Main items filed:
- **Company news:** the SEC request about the LJM deals and the 23 Oct all-employee meeting; McMahon named CFO with Fastow on leave.
- **Raptor:** on 22 Oct the owner told Bharati, with Andersen's Scardino copied, that he cannot support the group's past Raptor analysis.
- **Events:** he will chair a session at Gas & PoweRisk in Paris on 8 Nov. He handed SMS to Zimin Lu, the MIT Sloan panel to Shanbhogue and EPIS to Alex Huang.
- **Staff and hiring:** a JCC go-ahead; candidates Philoche, Kholodnyi, Calabrese and Sam Cho; Werner's move to Houston; a Research manager to go on loan to Jeff Andrews's EGM fundamentals group.

I opened people files for Karthik Rajan and Ozzie Pagan, whose fifth message arrived this week, and for Jeff Andrews, who passed five messages in May but never got a file. I added one question to `questions.md`: whether the Jeff Andrews interviewed in August 2000 is the same person; for now he stays one file marked (?). Nothing was due for a status-quo close, and the inbox held no sleep-task or feedback blocks. No file was above 90% of its ceiling, so the three-file compression quota had nothing to act on. Each touched file that was over target had its oldest lines moved verbatim into 20 new archive files dated 2001-10-24, and I rewrote `state.md` and refreshed the domain indexes. The three inbox logs and the run log are now in `memory/archive/inbox/`. I did not commit `dataset/runs/sleep-104.transcript.jsonl`, which was already untracked when I started.
